_comment: A funnel of loose ground cut into the surface, and the one shape in the geometric family that goes
down rather than up. It mints like any other pattern, so the clause names what it is full of:
Its unstated pool is loose ground rather than `#formation_substance`, and that is the whole
difference between this word and its siblings: an obelisk nobody gave a material to should be some
handsome stone, where a pit of polished granite is a monument somebody dug a hole for.
